_comment: Types that do not satisfy Send and/or Sync. Used by pyclass-traits-checker: since PyO3 0.23 a #[pyclass] requires Send + Sync (before 0.23, only Send). A field of one of these types makes the struct fail the bound unless #[pyclass(unsendable)] is set. `send`/`sync` record which bound the type itself breaks; container types (RefCell, Cell) are Send when their contents are Send but are never Sync.

types.note: Non-atomic reference count; use std::sync::Arc for a shareable handle.
Send if T: Send, but never Sync. For shared interior mutability use Mutex/RwLock.
Raw-pointer wrapper; neither Send nor Sync by default.
A held lock guard should almost never be a #[pyclass] field.
